subject: Invoice #1234 overdue
body:
Dear customer,
Our records show that invoice #1234 for $2,450 was due on October 15 and remains unpaid. Please arrange payment within 7 days to avoid a late fee. If you have already paid, please ignore this reminder.
Best regards,
Accounts Receivable

subject: Weekly engineering sync
body: Agenda: review the sprint backlog, discuss last night's production incident and the database latency spike, and plan the Kubernetes cluster upgrade. Please update your pull requests before the meeting.

subject: Company retreat announcement
body: We invite you to our annual company retreat in the mountains on June 12-14. The program includes team building activities and a wellbeing workshop for all employees. Our marketing team will capture photos and video for a social media campaign about our culture. HR will share travel arrangements next week.

subject: Cannot log in to my account
body: Hi support team, since yesterday I get an error message when I try to log in, and the password reset link is not working. Could you please help me?

subject: NDA for the new partnership
body: Please review the attached non-disclosure agreement before Friday. Our legal team added a confidentiality clause and needs your signature on the final contract.

subject: Special offer: upgrade to Premium
body: Thanks for the demo call last week. As discussed, here is a pricing quote with a 20% discount if you upgrade your subscription to the Premium plan this quarter.
